subject: SIG/CAIQ kickstart + clarifying items for HealthScale
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Carter <bethany@healthscale.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: SIG/CAIQ kickstart + clarifying items for HealthScale

Hi Bethany — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few asks so we can kick off the security intake cleanly from our side.

Recap from call:
- You liked the latency/throughput profile and want to evaluate Redwood for a production inference path for clinical triage.
- Security and data residency are gating items for procurement.

To move forward we usually start with a SIG/CAIQ prefill (saves time vs back-and-forth questionnaires). I've attached our prefill template (Redwood_SIG_prefill_template.xlsx) and our SOC 2 executive summary (SOC2-executive-summary.pdf) for context. Would you mind confirming the short list below so we can route the right evidence?

Key clarifying questions:
1) SOC 2 status — do you have a completed Type II report, or is it in progress? If in progress, expected completion date?
2) HIPAA exposure — will HealthScale be sending or processing PHI through Redwood for the initial pilots?
3) Data residency — do you require processing and storage to remain in a specific AWS region (us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, etc.)?
4) KMS / key control — do you need customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) or is our managed KMS acceptable?
5) Egress / export controls — any contractual restrictions on exporting data outside your VPC/region?
6) Third-party auditors — any additional compliance frameworks we should map (e.g., HITRUST, ISO 27001)?

If you prefer, we can start by asking you to fill the short list in the attached HealthScale_SIG_answers.pdf and return it; I can then loop in Naomi (security) to scope evidence. Proposed next step from my side: 1) you confirm Qs 1-6 or return the attached answers by end of week; 2) we kick off a SIG prefill and share a BAA DocuSign link (if HIPAA is applicable).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Bethany Carter <bethany@healthscale.ai>

Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2026 14:03:22 -0400
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ kickstart + clarifying items for HealthScale

Jordan — thanks for the summary and materials. Quick answers below and I attached a completed short-answer sheet (HealthScale_SIG_answers.pdf) to speed things up.

1) SOC 2: In progress. We completed gap remediation last quarter and engaged auditors in May — target Type II completion is end of Q4 2026 (expected report delivery by 2027-01-15). We can share the SOC 2 Type I and the remediation plan now.
2) HIPAA: Yes, our pilot will include PHI in limited scope (patient identifiers + unstructured clinical notes). We will need a signed BAA before production.
3) Data residency: We need processing to stay in AWS us-east-1 for the pilot.
4) KMS: Prefer customer-managed keys (we use AWS KMS with our own key policy). If Redwood supports CMK in private deployment, that would be ideal.
5) Egress: No exports outside us-east-1 for PHI. Non-PHI analytics can be aggregated in us-west-2.
6) Additional frameworks: HITRUST is on our roadmap but not required for the pilot. ISO 27001 is nice-to-have.

Timing question: how long does a full SIG/CAIQ prefill and evidence handoff usually take on your side? We have an internal security reviewer who can turn around evidence within ~7 business days once we have a clear request.

Thanks — Bethany
Bethany Carter
Head of Product Operations, HealthScale
bethany@healthscale.ai | +1 (617) 555-9800

Attachment: HealthScale_SIG_answers.pdf (pdf stub)

- SOC2 Type II expected 2027-01-15 (Type I available now).
- Pilot will include PHI; they require a BAA before production and processing restricted to us-east-1 for PHI.

Jordan — thanks, that helps. Quick follow-ups before we send a formal prefill:

1) Retention: what retention windows does HealthScale expect for model inputs and logs? We need to know if they want token-level logs persisted for >90 days or shorter.
2) Logging/data capture: will HealthScale allow redaction of direct identifiers prior to send (we can recommend client-side redaction patterns)?
3) BYOK requirements: confirm whether they require exclusive key control (we hold no key material) or if split-key/holding is acceptable.
4) Egress enforcement: for PHI we need an enforceable contract clause and capability to pin processing and storage to us-east-1. Confirm whether the pilot will involve any multi-region failover tests that would require temporary egress.
5) Subprocessors: we need the list of any third-party vendors who will be uploading data to the service on HealthScale's behalf.

Action items from security: Naomi will prepare a SIG-lite prefill with answers we can provide immediately (SOC2 exec summary, diagram of data flow for hosted vs dedicated, KMS options) and a prioritized evidence list for HealthScale to act on. Expect a draft within 48 hours.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
